changes.name: Security buffer pool: buffer size
changes.note: Buffer size for the security pool above (65536 covers every possible packet size). Only works together with the “how many” line.

changes.name: Security buffer pool: buffer size
changes.note: Buffer size for the login server’s security pool (65536 covers every possible packet size).

changes.name: Security buffer pool: how many
changes.note: Security protection added by L2Everdream: one pool that covers the largest possible network packet, which stops oversized packets from permanently using up server memory. Keep it together with the buffer size line below.

changes.name: Security buffer pool: how many
changes.note: Same security protection as the game server, for the login server’s port.

changes.name: Gatekeeper teleport price
changes.note: New setting added by L2Everdream (it needed a server code change). Scales the price of normal town gatekeeper teleports; shipped at 0.5 (half price). It does not affect dungeon, clan hall or noblesse teleport lists.

changes.name: Enable cursed weapons (Zariche, Akamanah)
changes.note: Cursed weapons (Zariche and Akamanah) are turned off until the mechanic is fully supported in L2Everdream.

changes.name: Remove dropped items after
changes.note: Dropped rewards stay on the ground for an hour instead of ten minutes. Herbs still disappear after their own 60 seconds.

changes.name: Path find buffers
changes.note: Larger and more numerous pathfinding buffers, so sims can find long routes across towns and many can path at once without walking into walls. Uses a little more memory.

changes.name: Show the login server window
changes.note: The login server runs without its own window; the L2Everdream launcher starts it in the background.

changes.name: Monsters give up when pulled too far
changes.note: Monsters give up and return home when pulled too far from where they spawned, instead of chasing forever (which dragged monsters into towns).

changes.name: Show NPC details on Shift+click
changes.note: Players can Shift+click monsters to see their stats and drop and spoil lists. Shipped on as a trial.

changes.name: Buffer pool auto expand capacity
changes.note: Network buffer pools can no longer grow without limit. Part of a security protection; if network speed ever seems off, this is the first thing to review.

changes.name: Buffer pool auto expand capacity
changes.note: Same protection as the game server: login server buffer pools can no longer grow without limit.

changes.name: When the leader leaves, pass leadership instead of disbanding
changes.note: When a party leader leaves, leadership passes to another member instead of the party breaking up, so sims recruited into a party keep hunting.

changes.name: Every new character on an account counts as a newbie
changes.note: Every new character counts as a newbie, not only the first one on an account, so each gets the newbie buffs and help.

changes.name: Teleports are free up to level
changes.note: Teleports are never free. Stock Mobius makes them free up to level 40, a rule from a later chronicle; retail Interlude charged every level.

changes.name: Manor crop harvest rate
changes.note: Manor harvests shipped at 15× to match the other rates.

changes.name: Party skill point rate
changes.note: Party skill point bonus shipped at 15× to match the skill point rate.

changes.name: Party experience rate
changes.note: Party experience bonus shipped at 15× to match the experience rate.

changes.name: Skill point (SP) rate
changes.note: Offline worlds ship at 15× skill points instead of retail 1×.

changes.name: Experience (XP) rate
changes.note: Offline worlds ship at 15× experience instead of retail 1×. The public L2Everdream worlds run at 1×.

changes.name: Create an account automatically on first login
changes.note: Unchanged value, but the release documents it: accounts are created automatically on first login, which suits a world on your own PC. A server open to the internet should turn this off.

files.summary: 39 line(s) added, 3 removed compared with stock. The launcher also rewrites this file when the world starts.
